title: Ticket Boundaries
summary: Prove and remediate broken object-level authorization across reads and writes.
description: ApertureOps needs evidence that ticket IDs never substitute for server-side ownership checks.

services.name: ticket-api
services.purpose: Synthetic ticket ownership and BOLA evidence service

objectives.title: Prove cross-owner object access
objectives.label: Compare vulnerable reads and writes with owner behavior

objectives.title: Verify ownership enforcement
objectives.label: Report fixed positive and negative ownership cases

learningOutcomes: Explain why an authenticated object ID is not authorization
Test read and write ownership with positive and negative cases
Recommend server-side owner scoping and per-operation checks
